<!-- עברית גם בסדר. Hebrew is fine. -->

**The gap.** What should the tool catch or do that it does not today? A real-world example —
an app, a snippet, an incident — beats an abstract idea.

**Rule, or declared row?** If it is a check: could a static scan decide it deterministically, or
is it honestly a `declared` / `undeterminable` row? Both are first-class answers here — see
`core/methodology/grade-or-declare.md`.

**Which domain** in `core/checks/` does it belong to, if any?
